item.title: The Road to Secure and Trusted AI
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Trusted AI", "Adversarial AI", "Cybersecurity", "Technology Trends"]
Summary:
  • Adversa published a detailed report on Trusted AI.
  • It explains threats and protection methods for AI technology.
  • The report reviews a decade of AI security with data and visuals.
  • It highlights targeted AI areas impacting business and economy.
  • The report offers steps for companies to secure AI.
  • It analyzes over 2000 research papers on adversarial AI attacks.

item.title: AI risk management for smart city
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Smart Cities", "Artificial Intelligence", "Risk Management", "Internet of Things", "Urban Technology"]
Summary:
  • Smart cities use electronic methods and IoT to collect data.
  • AI optimizes transport, parking, and utility management.
  • Smart city systems improve safety and comfort.
  • AI risks include data theft and system sabotage.
  • Security is critical for protecting residents and infrastructure.

item.title: AI risk management for marketplaces
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Digital Marketplaces", "Regulation and Compliance", "Cybersecurity", "E-commerce"]
Summary:
  • Most large digital marketplaces use AI technologies.
  • AI helps with content moderation and product recommendations.
  • The EU has regulations to manage AI risks in marketplaces.
  • Non-compliance with these laws can lead to heavy fines.
  • Marketplaces face threats from AI-based attacks.
  • Awareness of AI risks is crucial for marketplace owners.

item.title: AI risk management for media
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Media Industry", "Regulation and Compliance", "Content Moderation", "Cybersecurity"]
Summary:
  • AI benefits the media industry by enhancing content sharing and recommendations.
  • It helps filter and ban prohibited content automatically.
  • Media platforms face risks due to the volume of posts and potential misuse.
  • The EU introduced DMA and DSA regulations to combat illegal content and disinformation.
  • Non-compliance with these laws can lead to heavy fines.
  • Media companies using AI are vulnerable to cyberattacks.

item.title: AI risk management for Internet Industry
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Internet Industry", "Privacy and Security", "Risk Management", "Copyright Protection"]
Summary:
  • The Internet industry widely uses AI technologies.
  • AI applications include face and voice recognition.
  • AI systems face risks like privacy violations.
  • Attackers can deceive recognition systems.
  • Copyright detection may fail due to evasive content.
  • These risks highlight the need for AI risk management.

item.title: AI Risk Management for Automotive industry
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Automotive Industry", "Autonomous Vehicles", "Risk Management", "Transportation Technology"]
Summary:
  • Autonomous vehicles have advanced automotive technology.
  • AI handles driving tasks like parking and cruise control.
  • AI can alert drivers to hazards and control vehicle functions.
  • AI risks include traffic sign misrecognition.
  • Malicious stickers can trick AI systems.
  • Complete safety is still not guaranteed.

item.title: AI risk management for insurance
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Insurance Technology", "Risk Management", "Predictive Analytics", "Regulatory Compliance"]
Summary:
  • AI is transforming the insurance industry and enabling innovation.
  • AI improves customer service through chatbots.
  • It enhances underwriting using drone and satellite data.
  • Predictive analytics help manage risks and forecast claims.
  • AI risk management is crucial due to ethical and regulatory challenges.
  • Specialized platforms support secure AI adoption in insurance.

item.title: AI risk management for financial industry
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Financial Technology", "Risk Management", "Cybersecurity", "Regulatory Compliance"]
Summary:
  • AI improves efficiency and risk management in finance.
  • It enables faster decisions and personalized customer support.
  • AI poses risks like bias, errors, and cybersecurity threats.
  • Financial firms must ensure strong governance and compliance.
  • Collaboration with regulators is essential for safe AI use.

item.title: Top AI Security Incidents (2025 Edition)
item.description:
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Cybersecurity", "Artificial Intelligence", "GenAI Vulnerabilities", "Incident Analysis"]
Summary:
  • Adversa AI released a report on AI security incidents in 2025.
  • AI systems are failing in real-world scenarios.
  • Common failures include prompt injections and agent misalignment.
  • Attacks target APIs, memory, and control logic.
  • The report offers actionable defenses beyond standard security.
  • It is aimed at AI builders and defenders.

item.title: How TheFork Leverages Online Evals To Boost Conversions with Arize AX on AWS
item.description:
Author: Yesmine Rouis, Natalia Skaczkowska-Drabczyk
Date: December 09, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Machine Learning Operations", "Restaurant Technology", "Cloud Computing", "Customer Experience"]
Summary:
  • TheFork is a leading restaurant booking platform in Europe.
  • AI enhances customer experiences through review analysis and content extraction.
  • They use Arize AX on AWS to monitor and improve AI models.
  • This boosts conversion rates and reduces latency.
  • TheFork's AI approach shows strong enterprise AI practices.
